records.text: Erika Kirk began dating minor-league baseball player JT Massey in March 2014.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In March, we know that Erika (Erika Kirk) is going to begin dating somebody else, and his name is JT Massey, and he's a minor league baseball player.

verification.notes: The resurfaced 2014 Amazing Race audition identifies JT Massey as Erika Frantzve's boyfriend and a Colorado Rockies minor-league player; Massey states their first date was March 1. Current reporting independently describes the same tape and relationship.

sources.title: Yahoo Entertainment - Erika Kirk resurfaced audition video
sources.relevance: Reports the 2014 tape with then-boyfriend and minor-league player JT Massey.

records.text: JT Massey says his first date with Erika Frantzve was March 1, 2014, and that he picked her up at her home and met her mother that night.
records.speaker: Tyler Massey

appearances.snippet: So March 1st we went on our first date yes ... of different night in Arizona and picked her up at her house and later met her mom on the first night.

verification.notes: The direct audition recording contains Massey's March 1 first-date account, pickup at Erika's house, and meeting her mother that night. Current reporting on the resurfaced tape also identifies March 1 as the stated first date; no contrary evidence was found.

records.text: Candace Owens says there is evidence that Erika Kirk and JT Massey were engaged.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She really liked this guy, by the way, there's evidence that they were, they were even engaged. And so her whole demeanor is just so different from the person that she becomes with Charlie (Charlie Kirk). And we're supposed to believe that that's authentic.

verification.notes: Public evidence conclusively establishes a romantic relationship and 2014 audition tape, but current reporting treats engagement claims as rumor based on photos or unnamed accounts. No civil record, direct confirmation, or reliable contemporaneous announcement establishes an engagement.
